title: DR1 groups the dashboard filters into three collapsed sections a user opens one at a time — Search by, Status, By date; the frontend's filter panel is a single always-open block.

finding.frontend: The panel beside the list is headed "Filter notifications" as a third-level heading, with its one control — the keyword box and its Search button — always visible below it (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:38-56). With one control there is nothing to group, so the panel is as tall as its contents.
finding.prototype: DR1's panel carries the plain label "Filter notifications" and then three collapsed sections, each a summary row with a chevron: Search by, Status and By date (app/views/dashboard.html:83-227). On first load all three are shut, so the panel is three rows tall and the page opens with the list, not the filters, in the reader's eye; opening a section reveals only that section's controls. dr1-dashboard is the shut state and dr1-dashboard-filters-open is all three open.
finding.difference: Group the dashboard filters into three collapsible sections under a "Filter notifications" label, shut on load, using the same three section names DR1 uses. This is the container the other three filter findings put controls into, so it wants doing first or alongside them — on its own it collapses one keyword box behind a chevron, which is worse than what is there now. Match DR1's heading treatment too: DR1 labels the panel rather than heading it, so the sections are the only headed things inside it.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding DR1's filter controls all visible at once on first load of the dashboard, with no summary rows to open.
finding.correction: Sound, and every observable claim checks out. DR1 labels the panel with a paragraph rather than a heading, which is why the captured DR1 page model lists no heading between My notifications and the card references, while the frontend model records Filter notifications as a third-level heading. The three summary rows are shut in evidence/prototype@491b3926/page/dr1-dashboard.png and all three open in dr1-dashboard-filters-open.png, so the shut and open states are both photographed. One omission worth naming. This is the only one of the four filter findings that does not state in its own prose that DR1's sidebar is wired to nothing — the other three each say it plainly, and a reader of this one alone would not know. It is also the one finding that fact does not undermine, and that is the point: the collapsing behaviour is native details and summary markup, so it needs no form, no script and no query parameter to work, and it is the only part of DR1's filter panel that genuinely does what it appears to do. That is the argument for building this one first and on its own terms, and it belongs in the prose rather than only here.

relatedTo.why: the three search boxes are the contents of the Search by section this finding creates
the status select is the whole of the Status section
the radios and date pickers are the whole of the By date section
